facts.text: Vehicle interaction is the mining industry's term for any situation in which a moving machine comes close to another machine, a person or a fixed site feature, whether or not contact occurs.
facts.quote: Vehicle interaction is the mining industry's term for any situation in which a moving machine comes close to another machine, a person or a fixed feature of the site, whether or not contact happens.

facts.text: Regulators and EMESRT (Earth Moving Equipment Safety Round Table) use three vehicle-interaction classes: vehicle to vehicle, vehicle to person, and vehicle to environment, including berms, edges, walls and structures.
facts.quote: the three classes that regulators and the industry group EMESRT (Earth Moving Equipment Safety Round Table) use: vehicle to vehicle, vehicle to person, and vehicle to environment (berms, edges, walls, structures)

entities.name: Earth Moving Equipment Safety Round Table

facts.text: In 2023, New South Wales reported “no meaningful reduction” in reported vehicle interactions year on year.
facts.quote: New South Wales reported "no meaningful reduction" in reported vehicle interactions year on year (2023)

facts.text: In 2024, Queensland reported mobile plant collisions at the top of its high-potential incident list.
facts.quote: Queensland reports mobile plant collisions at the top of its high-potential incident list (2024)

facts.text: A NIOSH review found that most published research targets vehicle-to-vehicle interactions, whereas accident records contain many vehicle-to-environment events, including berm deaths.
facts.quote: a NIOSH review found most published work targets vehicle-to-vehicle interactions, while accident records contain many vehicle-to-environment events such as berm deaths

facts.text: EMESRT's performance requirement PR-5A turns vehicle interactions into a catalog of standard scenarios.
facts.quote: EMESRT's performance requirement PR-5A turns vehicle interactions into a catalog of standard scenarios

entities.name: Earth Moving Equipment Safety Round Table

facts.text: EMESRT's performance requirement PR-5A provides a nine-level model of controls for vehicle interactions.
facts.quote: EMESRT's performance requirement PR-5A turns vehicle interactions into a catalog of standard scenarios and a nine-level model of controls

entities.name: Earth Moving Equipment Safety Round Table

facts.text: Vehicle-interaction scenarios are the closest thing the off-road sector has to a ready-made test catalog.
facts.quote: The vehicle-interaction scenarios are the closest thing the off-road world has to a ready-made test catalog

facts.text: The booklet recommends building the operating-domain definition on ISO 21815 and the EMESRT scenarios.
facts.quote: the booklet recommends building the operating-domain definition on ISO 21815 and the EMESRT scenarios [Introduction, Chapter 1]

entities.name: Earth Moving Equipment Safety Round Table

facts.text: A system detecting only vehicles and people leaves the vehicle-to-environment class of vehicle interactions unaddressed.
facts.quote: a system detecting only vehicles and people leaves the environment class unaddressed.
